key_findings: After peripheral nerve injury, spinal dorsal horn microglia overexpress P2X4R, which is important for tactile allodynia in neuropathic pain.
Microglial P2X4R stimulation releases BDNF, causing a depolarizing shift of Eanion in secondary sensory neurons.
